messages.content: Help me update the contents of a file in the non-blocking file system with an input stream `fileStream`, ensuring that the operation is forced and history is not kept, while monitoring the progress with `progressMonitor`?

function.name: EFSNIOFile_setContents
function.description: Sets the contents of a file with data from the provided InputStream, with options to force the operation and to keep or discard the file history. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

source.description: The InputStream from which file contents are read. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

force.description: If true, the operation is forced, otherwise it's a normal set content operation. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

keepHistory.description: If true, keeps the file history, otherwise discards it. This is Java boolean type parameter in string representation.

monitor.description: The IProgressMonitor to report progress of the operation. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
